response.query: Which mechanisms will be primary (investment, R&D, firm entry/exit, plant‑level reallocation), and what mediation or IV strategies will identify each channel?
response.answer: Investment, R&D, firm entry/exit, and plant-level reallocation are primary mechanisms. Instrumental variable strategies are often used to identify these channels.
